zh.panelSettings.notify.title: 通知设置
zh.panelSettings.notify.desc: 管理员邮箱同时用于接收通知与找回密码（只有匹配该邮箱的请求才会发信）。
zh.panelSettings.notify.email.hint: 接收通知与重置验证码
zh.panelSettings.notify.offline.desc: Agent 断开时发信；同一次离线只发一封（24 小时后补发提醒），抖动重连不刷屏
zh.panelSettings.notify.recovery.desc: 仅在发送过离线通知后生效
zh.panelSettings.ai.title: AI 日志分析
zh.panelSettings.ai.desc: 实例详情页「AI 分析」用它解读控制台日志；接口需兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions，密钥仅保存在本机。
zh.panelSettings.ai.base.invalid: 需以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
zh.panelSettings.ai.model.hintFetch: 可点右侧「查询模型」拉取列表
zh.panelSettings.ai.key.hintMissing: 填写密钥后才能查询模型或测试连接
zh.panelSettings.ai.fetchModels.tooltip: 用上面的接口地址与密钥拉取服务商模型列表
zh.panelSettings.ai.fetchModels.error.noneD: 请检查接口地址与密钥，或手动填写模型名
zh.panelSettings.ai.privacy: 分析时会把实例控制台日志（最多最近 500 行，即 Agent 缓冲的全部内容）发给模型；日志可能含玩家名与地址，请自行确认服务商可信。

en.panelSettings.notify.title: Notifications
en.panelSettings.notify.desc: The admin email receives notifications and password-reset codes (only requests matching this email trigger outgoing mail).
en.panelSettings.notify.offline: Notify when a server goes offline
en.panelSettings.notify.offline.desc: Sends an email when an Agent disconnects; one email per outage (a reminder follows after 24 hours). Reconnect flapping won't spam your inbox
en.panelSettings.notify.recovery: Notify when a server is back online
en.panelSettings.notify.recovery.desc: Only applies after an offline notification was sent
en.panelSettings.ai.title: AI log analysis
en.panelSettings.ai.desc: Powers the "AI analysis" tab on the instance detail page to interpret console logs; the endpoint must be OpenAI Chat Completions compatible, and the key is stored locally only.
en.panelSettings.ai.base.invalid: Must start with http:// or https://
en.panelSettings.ai.model.hintFetch: Click "Fetch models" on the right to load the list
en.panelSettings.ai.key.hintSaved: Saved; leave blank to keep it
en.panelSettings.ai.key.hintMissing: Enter the API key to fetch models or test the connection
en.panelSettings.ai.fetchModels.tooltip: Fetch the provider's model list using the endpoint and key above
en.panelSettings.ai.fetchModels.error.noneD: Check the endpoint and key, or enter the model name manually
en.panelSettings.ai.privacy: Analysis sends the instance console log (at most the last 500 lines, i.e. everything the Agent buffers) to the model; logs may contain player names and addresses, so make sure you trust the provider.
